reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Handwritten. NOTATION: the filer writes cents as a raised/superscript pair after the dollars ('550' with a superscript '00', '2,703' with a superscript '70') and prefixes each cell with a hand-drawn '$'; transcribed here in ordinary decimal form with the '$' dropped, exactly as written otherwise (line 6 has no thousands comma on the page, lines 1-2 do). Lines 3 and 5 are written over earlier digits - the pen has been retraced through the middle zeros/fives - so 3000.00 and 3550.00 are recorded at medium confidence as the surviving values; nothing was arithmetic-derived. The summary page's own last-name and Date of Report header boxes are blank; report_date is the cover-page signature date.

contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED ($550.00) on the p2 Summary Page, repeated by the same page's line 4 'Total Contributions Received (From Line 1 Column A) $550.00'. The filer filed NO county Schedule A, so there is no schedule-level subtotal to gate against; the ledger page prints no contributions total either.
contributions.detail: 2 typed ledger contribution lines sum to 500.00 + 50.00 = 550.00 exactly = the cover's promoted PER-PERIOD Column A cell = summary line 4. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 550.00 and is NOT summed as an increment (first report of the cycle, so period and YTD coincide). THE HANDWRITTEN $3,000.00 'Personal loan / Doug Witney' ENTRY ON THE SAME LEDGER IS DELIBERATELY NOT AN ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION ROW, and this is traced, not assumed: the filer's own cover assigns exactly 3,000.00 to line 3, 'Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period', and NOT to line 1 or line 4, and the whole ladder closes on that assignment — line 3 3,000.00 + line 4 550.00 = line 5 subtotal 3,550.00; 3,550.00 - line 6 2,703.70 = line 7 close 846.30. Adding the loan to the contribution rows would produce 3,550.00 against a stated 550.00 and would silently re-classify the filer's own accounting, which this transcription does not do. The loan is recorded in full in `notes` (date 5-11-2010, 'Personal loan', Doug Witney of Springville, UT, $3,000.00 with raised cents) so nothing about it is lost.

expenditures.anchor: the ledger page's OWN printed column total, $2,703.70, standing at the foot of the Expenditures column, which equals the p2 Summary Page's Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($2,703.70) and its line 6 ($2703.70, cents written raised)
expenditures.detail: 20 typed ledger expenditure lines sum to 519.48 + 50.00 + 28.43 + 6.91 + 9.76 + 20.00 + 61.33 + 59.33 + 106.47 + 95.55 + 186.10 + 62.80 + 20.00 + 332.50 + 6.15 + 31.40 + 155.66 + 14.13 + 437.70 + 500.00 = 2,703.70 exactly = the ledger's own printed total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell = line 6 of the balance ladder. Column B YTD 2,703.70 is the same figure (first report of the cycle) and is retained as cumulative, never summed as an increment.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only closed both sides (550.00 / 2,703.70); the monetary-plus-in-kind convention was tested and is identical because nothing on the ledger is marked in-kind and neither the ledger nor the county form prints an in-kind column. Two expenditure lines describe goods given away ('Contribution at M&M Eagle Mt.', 'Candy for Meet and Mingle') but the filer reports them as cash spending, and they are transcribed where he put them.
itemized.escalation_note: Three tight crops at 700-900 dpi, all legibility/geometry rather than arithmetic (both sides had already closed on printed totals): the expenditure column's first and last amount boxes rendered '$519.48' and '$500.00'; the contribution column's two amount boxes rendered '$500.00' and '$50.00'; and a 700 dpi crop of the handwritten block resolved it as '5-11-2010 Personal loan / Doug Witney / [street] Springville, UT / $3000.00' with the cents written raised.

itemized.notes: legacy_colAB COVER + SUMMARY, but NO COUNTY SCHEDULE A OR SCHEDULE B EXISTS IN THIS FILING — a document property, verified with pdfinfo (3 pages total): p1 cover ('Seven days preceding the Primary Election', signed 'May 9 2010', amendment box marked No, stamped received MAY 11), p2 SUMMARY PAGE (header box left blank by the filer), p3 the candidate's OWN typed LANDSCAPE ledger headed 'Douglas Witney / Campaign Contributions/Expenditures', carrying both sides side by side with their own column headers. Both sides are `transcribed` (the lines were read) — the absence is of the county's schedule FORMS, not of the entries. Because both sides live on one sheet, itemized_pages_A and itemized_pages_B are both '3'. THE FILER'S CENTS NOTATION: the cover writes cents as a raised/superscript pair ('550' with a raised '00'); the ledger prints ordinary decimals. A HANDWRITTEN ADDITION on the ledger's contribution side, dated 5-11-2010 (the day the clerk stamped the filing received, two days after the signature), reads 'Personal loan / Doug Witney / [street] Springville, UT / $3000.00' with raised cents. It is NOT carried as a contribution row: the cover assigns exactly 3,000.00 to line 3, Balance at Beginning of Reporting Period, and the entire ladder closes on that assignment (3,000.00 + 550.00 = 3,550.00; less 2,703.70 = 846.30). Recorded here in full so the disclosure is preserved; not re-classified, per the standing rule against adjudicating a filer's own accounting. PAGE-FACE candidate name is 'Douglas Witney' (Republican, residence city Springville) — index.csv names NO candidate for this row; page-face Office Seeking reads 'Utah County Commission Seat B', agreeing with index.csv. Not a *_Redacted.pdf — published in the clear, so donor street lines were visible and were reduced to city at READ TIME.
